question: You chose head of household. Do all of these apply to you for 2025: on December 31, 2025 you were unmarried, or considered unmarried (for example, married but your spouse did not live in your home for the last 6 months of 2025); you paid more than half the cost of keeping up your home for 2025; and a qualifying person, such as your child or a relative you can claim as a dependent, lived with you there for more than half of 2025 (a dependent parent need not live with you if you paid more than half the cost of your parent's main home for all of 2025)? If any of these does not apply, you cannot file as head of household; change your filing status.
